investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Copperbrook Education (online learning); Platform: AWS ap-northeast-1 (zones ap-northeast-1a/ap-northeast-1c/ap-northeast-1d); network range 10.240.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster copper-prod-apnort (EKS); Database: postgres server certificate-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-8e64f6ff810de181c; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
